snippets.output: Singulair (also known as montelukast) is an oral medication, not an inhaler.
Montelukast is a leukotriene receptor antagonist.
Montelukast is used for the prophylaxis and treatment of chronic asthma, the prevention of exercise-induced bronchoconstriction, and the symptomatic relief of allergic rhinitis.
snippets.notes: Atom 7 ("prophylaxis of chronic asthma") is expert-false — montelukast is used for chronic management/treatment, not prophylaxis of the chronic disease itself; merged with the other indications since the response presents them as one list.
